rationale: Lydia brings deep expertise in developer experience and agentic tooling (her current focus on Claude Code at Anthropic) while Georgi is building Rilo, an AI-agent platform for GTM automation that needs exactly this kind of technical credibility and education strategy. Lydia's conviction that great tooling communication unlocks ecosystem adoption directly complements Georgi's community-led distribution model through hackathons and builder events—she could help shape how Rilo's agent workflows are explained to and adopted by startup teams.
intro_message: Lydia Hallie, meet Georgi — he's building Rilo, an AI-agent GTM automation platform, and could benefit from your expertise in making complex agentic workflows intuitive for developers and non-technical operators alike.
